questions.q: What does Peterson say you should create before trying to become your ideal self?
a: A clear vision of who you want to be
questions.why: He writes that with a vision and dedicated action you can shape yourself.

questions.q: How does confronting fear help you according to the summary?
a: It lets you master challenges and move toward your vision
questions.why: He says staying focused on your vision lets you master fears over time.

questions.q: What simple change did Peterson make to his office to add beauty?
a: He painted the walls and hung bright art
He moved to a new building
questions.why: After his paneling plan was rejected, he compromised with paint and colorful art.

questions.q: Why does the author argue beauty matters beyond keeping a tidy space?
a: Because aesthetic experiences expand how we view the world
Because beauty is more important than health
questions.why: He notes that focusing only on order can cause us to miss the equally important role of beauty.

questions.q: What attitude does Peterson recommend when suffering occurs?
a: Be grateful for the perspective hardship provides
questions.why: He teaches to remember why we feel this way and be grateful for insight.
